item.title: Terror en una escuela de Filipinas: asesinato-suicidio transmitido en Facebook con una cámara corporal
item.description: Un hecho que conmociona a Filipinas y vuelve a poner bajo la lupa a las redes sociales y las armas. Un estudiante de secundaria mató a un compañero de clases y causó pánico mientras transmitía todo en streaming mediante una cámara corporal, antes de suicidarse. El perpetrador, un joven de entre 14 y 15 años, usó dos armas, entre ellas una pistola de su padre, que es funcionario en una oficina de aduanas. Se trata del segundo tiroteo de este tipo que tiene lugar en el país en los últimos dos meses y sigue a otro incidente similar en una escuela de Tailandia, ocurrido el 8 de agosto. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Show HN: Openleetcode – local LeetCode runner where tests live in the repo
item.description: You write a standard solution, just like on LeetCode, and run it through the CLI. It identifies the problem by ID or title, executes your code against local test cases, and shows the result. It currently supports around 1.4k problems and multiple languages, including Python, C++, Rust, Java, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and others. The project is still an MVP. System design, SQL, and concurrency problems are not supported yet, but support for more problem types is planned. Made in Haskell! item.title: In 1919, German crews sank 52 warships at Scotland's Scapa Flow; decades later...
item.description: Following their scuttling in 1919, fifty-two German warships found their final resting place in Scapa Flow. Remarkably, the steel salvaged from these wrecks has been pivotal in numerous modern scientific innovations. This unique pre-nuclear steel has been instrumental in constructing sensitive radiation detectors that safeguard medical imaging and deep-space probes from erroneous readings. To this day, seven of these historic vessels remain preserved for their heritage. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
